name: Unistar Multimedia Limited
summary: Unistar Multimedia Limited operates within the dynamic media and entertainment sector. The company specializes in a broad range of creative endeavors, including the creation of cinematic productions, encompassing both motion pictures and specialized motivational and educational films. Additionally, Unistar provides comprehensive event organization and talent representation services. It also functions as a content provider, developing television programming for a variety of platforms such as satellite, cable, and terrestrial broadcasters. Established on April 8, 1991, the firm maintains its headquarters in Mumbai, India.
